title: Senior Trust & Safety Engineer
description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Senior Software Engineer in Trust & Safety, you'll own the systems that decide how tradespeople are checked, how reviews are processed and how our marketplace stays honest at scale. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so. The job, unfiltered: Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated. Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom. Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick. Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it. Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent. The fit: Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment. Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you. Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists. Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it. Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs. Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix. An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better. Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them. You don't need to know our Trust & Safety domain yet (the review lifecycle, vetting disposition logic, publish timing). You'll pick it up. What matters is that you learn fast and take it seriously. (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) What you get 💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme 🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support 🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme 🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme ❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more How this goes Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners Technical interview with members of the team Final stage with the hiring manager and a senior stakeholder Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits. About us We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business. We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in. description: Recruitment Lead London | Full-time | Hybrid | Shoreditch/Liverpool Street We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us. Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel. Recruitment at Duffel We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to both manage our in-house recruiting team and be an on the ground recruiter, partnering with leaders on recruitment strategy and ensuring we maintain a consistently high hiring bar as we scale. About the role: What you’ll be doing: Manage a team of recruiters setting workload priorities, running 1:1s, keeping a pulse on pipelines, and supporting their development Partner closely with leaders on recruitment strategy and delivery across all functions, with a particular focus on scaling technical hiring Maintain and improve a structured interview infrastructure so the whole team runs a consistent, high-signal process Use data and insight to ensure a strong recruitment infrastructure, tracking and reporting on hiring KPIs through, quality-control on pipelines, and leaning on Ashby workflows Be the escalation point for hiring managers when a process isn't working Own end to end hiring, personally running search and building pipelines on technical, senior or niche roles alongside the team What we're looking for: Extensive recruiting experience at a tech first company, including owning hiring metrics and reporting to senior leaders, not just running requisitions. Meaningful experience hiring mid to senior software engineers across the stack, with a clear view of where engineering hiring breaks down: assessment design, competing offers, counter-offers and sourcing by specialism. Experience leading, coaching and developing experienced recruiters, including planning team capacity against a hiring plan and rebalancing workload, rather than managing day to day. Strong data literacy in Ashby: you can read a hiring funnel and pinpoint where it's breaking using Time to Hire, Time to Fill, stage conversion, offer acceptance and source-of-hire data. Confident in forecasting capacity and demand: you can turn a hiring plan into recruiter headcount, lead times and the date each opening needs to go live, and flag early when a plan can't be delivered. A strategic, commercially minded approach: you can turn data into a prioritised plan with clear baselines, targets and expected ROI (e.g. agency spend versus in-house capacity). A quality-over-quantity mindset, with experience defining and tracking Quality of Hire and using it to steer where you source candidates and how the team hires. Adept at building and improving recruitment processes and infrastructure, with a strong grasp of structured interviewing, scorecards and assessment design, and a focus on great candidate and interviewer experiences. A champion of clean data and documentation: from interview guides to Ashby set-up (Jobs and Openings, sources, archive reasons). You keep Ashby accurate enough that leaders trust the numbers. Excellent stakeholder management: comfortable pushing back on hiring managers and execs with evidence when the plan or process needs it, in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business. ✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world. 🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy. ⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings. ⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day. 📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme. 🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans. 🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption) The Details 📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays). 🧠 Interview Process: Recruiter Screen Hiring Manager Chat Technical Case Study Final Stage Interview We are an equal opportunities employer. title: Executive Assistant
description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We’re looking for a highly organised & proactive Executive Assistant for our Executives. You will be the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, ensuring efficiency and seamless operations. Your focus will be on managing key personal & professional priorities, and providing administrative and strategic support—allowing our execs to focus on scaling the business through the next phase of growth! You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time as we’re scaling fast and building the category-defining agentic operating system for procurement. And we are looking for the best Executive Assistant out there to help us turn procurement into a true competitive advantage! What Can You Expect? As the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, you’ll proactively coordinate, manage and keep track of your assigned Exec's schedules, projects and commitments. You will work closely with the Omnea leadership team and act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders on all matters related to our execs. You are someone who acts like an owner, can craft at speed and loves working in a fast-paced environment with significant impact. You’ll provide strategic and executive support , by managing our executives' complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling across multiple time zones. You’ll own email and communication filtering as well as prioritising, drafting, and responding as necessary. You’ll act as a gatekeeper , ensuring our executives’ time is spent on high-impact activities. You will manage conflicting priorities and prioritise different demands, you’ll focus on solutions, and are comfortable navigating change and removing blockers. You’ll plan, schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure agendas are well prepped, action items tracked, minutes taken and follow-ups done in a timely manner. You’ll also assist with board materials, investor updates, and briefing notes. You’ll organise and book all travel , including flights, hotels, transfers and visas. You’ll prepare detailed travel itineraries and handle last-minute changes seamlessly. You’ll own all operational and administrative tasks, such as expenses, invoices, and budget tracking related to our executives' activities. You’ll act as the first point of contact for all key stakeholders, including prospects and customers on behalf of our executives. You’ll manage confidential information with the highest level of discretion. You’ll also proactively solve problems and anticipate potential issues before they arise. You’ll own systems & processes that improve productivity, such as identifying and implementing tools or processes that reduce admin workload and help outsource and delegate non-essential tasks effectively. About You You have a 3-5 years of work experience , this can be as an EA, PA, Chief of Staff or Founders Associate ideally in a high-growth startup or tech environment. You may not have the exact experience necessary for this role but you will have excelled at something incredibly challenging that demonstrates your ability to work hard under pressure in a fast-paced, stressful environment. For example, you may be a career changer who did well in a different sector or role but similarly intense & difficult. You are London-based , with 3 days in the office per week and flexibility for occasional travels with the CEO in the future. You are highly organised, with meticulous attention to detail , and exceptional at multitasking. You have flexibility to provide support during off-hours in an environment with increasingly different timezones (Europe & US). You are tech-savvy , with experience using modern productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Notion, Google Suite). You can provide structure within the entrepreneurial and dynamic environment of a company in hyper-scale. You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are proactive, a strategic thinker, efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality (i.e. you have taste). You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You handle confidential matters with discretion and professionalism. You’re outcomes-focused , and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”. You are proactive & crave accountability , proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you. You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you. Please note: we are unable to sponsor visas or relocation for this role At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. It reports jointly to the Chief People Officer and the Chief AI Officer, because doing this well is as much about people, capability and how Unity actually works day to day as it is about the technology itself. It suits someone who lives at the frontier of what's possible with AI — building with the latest tools themselves and evolving their own approach every few weeks, not working from a playbook that's a year out of date. It suits someone who gets real satisfaction from building capability in others, reimagining how work actually gets done, and shipping things that stick, rather than setting technology direction from the top. You'll be building the operational muscle of Unity's AI Centre of Excellence from scratch, and sequencing what matters most first. What you'll own Firm-wide AI capability and training: design and drive practical AI upskilling across client-facing and enablement teams, working closely with the Performance & Development Lead so AI capability is built into onboarding and ongoing development, not run as a separate initiative Reimagining the work: spot where new AI capability means Unity can remove whole steps or approach a problem completely differently, not just automate what already exists, then get alongside client teams and enablement functions to make it real Automation and adoption: identify, prioritise and deliver automation that maximises the value Unity gets from the AI tools already in use, and evaluate new ones on their merits Role and ways-of-working design: as AI takes on more of the work, help Unity rethink who does what, where judgement sits and how junior people learn — including, as whole workflows move onto Weaver, designing the team and role changes that follow: new responsibilities around workflow ownership, supervision, judgement and exceptions Governance in practice: implement the policies and guardrails the Chief AI Officer sets for safe, compliant and ethical AI use — covering data privacy and client confidentiality — making sure they're followed in practice without slowing teams down Build, ship and partner with Engineering: personally build and ship smaller tools and prototypes using the latest AI capabilities; We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers. Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers. We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated. This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building. What you'll do Daily funding controls (core responsibility) Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved. Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it. Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit. Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early. Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them. Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions. Payments and finance operations Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers. Prepare and check payment files for approval, for example, bulk payment files for customer refunds and complaint redress. Pick up Finance Help Desk tickets from other teams: payment traces, refund and redress requests, "has this payment arrived" queries. Partner indemnity recovery Support the colleague who leads our partner indemnity recovery process. Where an agreement is cancelled, unwound or found to have been mis-sold, our partner agreements entitle us to recover amounts from the partner. You'll help validate each case against our records: confirming the agreement status, the amounts paid out and received, and what is contractually recoverable. Prepare and reconcile the recovery figures that go to partners, track invoices raised against amounts received, and chase and resolve queries and shortfalls. Support the unwind process on cancelled agreements: making sure customer refunds, partner recoveries and internal ledger entries all tie back to the same numbers. Help bring the recovery backlog under control and keep an accurate, up-to-date view of what is outstanding by partner. What we're looking for Must have A degree (2:1 or above, or equivalent) in a STEM, finance, accounting, economics or other quantitative subject, completed within the last two years. Strong numeracy and comfort working with large volumes of transactional data. Strong attention to detail and healthy scepticism. You can quickly identify when supporting documentation, such as a bank statement, does not fully evidence what it is intended to. Confident with Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, filters and tidy, checkable working. Clear written communication. You can explain to a non-finance colleague why a payment has been held. Confident dealing with external partners: obtaining documentation promptly and professionally, and politely pushing back where it is incomplete. Comfortable handling sensitive customer, partner and payment data responsibly. Nice to have Some exposure to Python, SQL or a similar language from your degree, a project or self-study, and an appetite to use it to automate repetitive work. We use Snowflake. An internship, placement or project involving finance, operations or messy real-world data. An interest in payments, lending or how money moves between businesses. What success looks like at 6 months The daily funding control runs reliably across the agreed partner population with a full evidence trail, and no payment is released without the previous day's funds being evidenced. Exceptions and emerging trends are flagged early, documented and resolved with the right teams. Partner and payee bank details have been verified on the agreed cycle. The partner indemnity recovery backlog has been validated, invoiced where due and is tracked in one accurate, up-to-date view. The funding control is documented end-to-end and materially more automated than when you started. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife The team Unsecured Personal Loans is one of Zopa’s largest and most established products, sitting at the heart of the bank’s growth ambitions. As a Product Manager in UPL Growth, you will own a meaningful part of how we originate loans: the decisioning, data and product journeys that determine who we can lend to, how confidently we can make an offer, and how simply customers can access one. This is far more than keeping a mature product moving. You will have the space to identify the biggest opportunities to improve conversion, eligibility and growth, then take them from a commercial hypothesis through discovery and delivery into measurable results. That might mean rethinking how we use third-party data, improving a partner journey, or changing the rules and logic behind our lending decisions. You will work in a small, ambitious product team alongside three flexible backend engineering teams, with close partnership from Credit Risk, Data Science and First Line Risk. The work is complex, fast-moving and consequential: the decisions you shape will directly influence customer outcomes and the scale of Zopa’s lending business. The work sits closer to commercial and analytical reasoning than to customer discovery — you will spend as much time interrogating data, sizing opportunities and shaping decisioning logic as you will running user research. If that sounds like the kind of PM work you are drawn to, this role is built for you. A day in the life Own a defined area of the UPL growth roadmap, from opportunity sizing through to launch, measurement and iteration. Turn commercial and customer signals into a clear product strategy, choosing where to focus and what not to pursue. Shape the origination and decisioning experience, including the rules, journeys and data that sit behind a customer receiving a loan offer. Lead cross-functional discovery with Engineering, Credit Risk and Data Science to find the most valuable, feasible route to growth. Develop propositions that give customers greater clarity and confidence before they invest time in a full application. Make the call on scope and sequencing, balancing customer value, risk, commercial return and engineering effort. Use data to uncover friction, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of your work. Bring new growth ideas into the roadmap, from smarter use of existing data to new external data sources and partner opportunities. Translate complex lending and technical problems into decisions that senior stakeholders can align behind. Build, launch and continually improve products that help Zopa move closer to becoming the UK’s leading unsecured lender. About you You are analytically strong and comfortable using data to find non-obvious product insight. You have made product decisions that delivered measurable commercial outcomes. You can partner closely with engineers through scope and timeline trade-offs. You approach ambiguous problems with sound judgement and a bias for practical progress. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders across technical and risk-focused teams. You are motivated by growth, efficiency and business impact. Added bonus Experience in lending, consumer credit or related financial products. Familiarity with originations, underwriting, pricing or servicing. A quantitative foundation through study or equivalent experience. Experience in a fast-paced, data-led fintech environment. At Zopa we value flexible ways of working. We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week. You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one. *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice Diversity Statement Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. Our approach to AI in interviews At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way. You'll partner closely with Design, Product Management, Clinical, and Engineering to design a best-in-class telemedicine experience across the sexual health journey, from first visit through ongoing treatment. Design with AI, Natively Bring an AI-native workflow to your craft — using AI tools for research synthesis, rapid concept generation, prototyping, and content/copy exploration — to move faster from insight to tested concept. Build Toward the Future App Translate where sexual health care is headed into concrete product direction. Partner with Product and Clinical to define a longer-term vision for the category, and design the connective tissue between today's app and that future state — so every current iteration is also a step toward it. Champion the User Deeply understand the needs, anxieties, and behaviors of people seeking sexual health care — a category where trust, discretion, and empathy are as important as usability. title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. Benefits Be part of a creative, world-leading team Competitive salary and share options scheme Contributory pension scheme Group private medical insurance scheme Life Assurance Cycle-to-work Scheme Central London location EEO Statement Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010. description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? What you will own: Strategic Account Development Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts with ACV in the £50k–£300k+ range — and the mandate to grow them. Build and maintain a live account plan for every account in your portfolio: org map, stakeholder matrix, expansion roadmap, commercial milestones, and renewal forecast. Build and present business cases and ROI frameworks at executive level that justify six-figure commercial commitments. Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles — champion, technical buyer, economic buyer, procurement, legal — with discipline and patience. Open Statista+ conversations where accounts are using Statista data to brief decisions — positioning the analytical layer as a natural next step. Protect GRR and Drive NRR Own renewal outcomes for every account in your portfolio. Renewals are the floor. Expansion is the ceiling. Monitor and act on usage signals, stakeholder changes, and risk indicators before they become churn conversations. Run high-quality QBRs that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and create the commercial conversations that expansion depends on. Partner with the CSM aligned to your accounts to ensure adoption, value realisation, and renewal are a joined-up motion. Represent Statista in the Market Operate as a credible commercial partner at VP and C-suite level — the person clients call when they are making strategic data and intelligence decisions, not just when they need to renew a licence. Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and the StatistaIQ roadmap — in every enterprise engagement. Contribute account intelligence to the commercial planning process — where are the opportunities, where are the risks, what is the market telling us? What we are looking for: Essential Significant B2B enterprise account management experience with a track record of protecting and growing strategic accounts at £100k+ ACV. Proven ability to move relationships from operational contacts to economic buyers — and to run commercial conversations at VP and C-suite level. Evidence of running complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles with rigour and discipline — not just renewing what exists. Strong consultative and discovery skills — you can run a client conversation that uncovers problems the client hasn’t articulated yet, and build a business case that justifies the investment. Commercial instinct for expansion — you see whitespace, surface latent needs, and progress expansion conversations with the same discipline as new business. Self-directed and ownership-minded — you run your accounts with the commercial rigour of a business owner, not the activity of a relationship manager. Desirable Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms. Familiarity with consumption-based or API-led commercial models. Exposure to enterprise procurement, compliance, and risk conversations in regulated industries (financial services, consulting, healthcare, technology). Experience working across multiple European markets. Fluency in a European language (French, German, Dutch) is advantageous. Why join Statista? A portfolio of enterprise accounts with significant untapped commercial headroom — the mandate to unlock it is yours. A product story that keeps getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you genuinely differentiated propositions to build enterprise relationships around. Direct partnership with the Head of KAM EMEA and VP Sales EMEA — senior support, fast decisions, and a clear mandate. A market where AI transformation is creating urgency around trusted, source-attributed data — Statista is in the right place at the right time. Real progression. Build a world-class portfolio here and you will be one of the most commercially credible enterprise account managers in the data and intelligence space. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! title: Account Executive - [UK&I]
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape. If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta: Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities. Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes. Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals. Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value. Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices. Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter. Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets. Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals. How to be successful in this role: 3+ years closing experience Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Media Team 👋 Trainline Media is an emerging part of Trainline's strategy, with real momentum behind it. The team brings together sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, and is moving from an early pilot into its next phase of growth. It sits within a business where advertising is one part of a broader, operationally focused whole. This role suits someone who enjoys building: shaping team culture, defining how the function works and making thoughtful, steady progress. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help embed our software capitalisation process working closely with our engineering and business teams to create an automated and scalable solution.</li> <li>Take on the role of product owner for the financial reporting processes of software capitalisation, operating key controls across month end close and performing impairment assessments.</li> <li>Use your strong technical knowledge of relevant IFRS standards for capitalisation and impairment to support and challenge the business on areas of judgement and documentary evidence.</li> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£60,000 - £65,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Client Success Senior Manager
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts, owning the post-sale relationship and driving client retention, engagement, and commercial outcomes. This is a hands-on, client-facing role suited for someone who is comfortable managing complexity, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working cross-functionally to deliver impact. The role is hybrid, with an expectation to be in the office 2x per week. YOUR IMPACT Own the post-sale lifecycle for a portfolio of large enterprise clients, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring long-term partnership success. Build and maintain trusted relationships with HR, Reward, and Wellbeing stakeholders across complex client organisations. Drive client adoption, engagement, and retention by translating client goals into clear success and engagement plans. Lead renewals and support expansion opportunities within your portfolio, clearly articulating value and impact. Use data and insights to monitor performance, identify risks, and recommend improvements to client strategy. Collaborate closely with internal teams (Wellbeing Engagement, Operations, Customer Experience, User Growth, Partnerships, Commercial) to ensure effective delivery. Proactively identify issues and risks, clearly articulating client impact and urgency to your manager to enable timely escalation and resolution. WHO YOU ARE 8+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role. Experience managing mid-to-large enterprise clients in a complex, fast-paced environment. Comfortable owning renewals and participating in commercial conversations with clients. Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders. Data-aware, with confidence using insights and reporting to inform decisions and conversations. Highly organised, able to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously. A collaborative, resilient professional who remains calm and solution-oriented when navigating change and complexity. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in driving new business growth and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. HEALTHCARE: Health and dental insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. title: Senior UX Researcher (f/m/d)
description: <p></p> <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>Are you passionate about uncovering meaningful user insights and influencing product decisions through evidence-based research? We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher to lead strategic and tactical research initiatives across our platform, helping teams better understand our customers and make informed decisions with confidence. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and other customer facing teams to plan and deliver impactful research. You'll be comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and driving research projects forward from inception to outcome with minimal oversight. Our team is a group of collaborative, curious, and dedicated people who care deeply about creating great experiences for our customers. Alongside meaningful work, we offer a supportive environment and a range of excellent benefits.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be responsible for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading end-to-end research projects, from problem definition and scoping through to synthesis, recommendations, and stakeholder alignment</li> <li>Planning and executing a range of qualitative and quantitative research activities, including usability testing, interviews, surveys, workshops, and behavioural analysis</li> <li>Translating complex research findings into clear, actionable insights that drive product and business decisions</li> <li>Managing multiple research initiatives simultaneously, balancing competing priorities while maintaining quality and momentum</li> <li>Collaborating closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and Commercial teams to identify research opportunities and answer high-value business questions</li> <li>Communicating research findings confidently and effectively to a range of audiences, from practitioners to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Influencing product strategy through evidence-based recommendations and championing customer needs across the organisation</li> <li>Helping teams navigate ambiguity by identifying research approaches, defining next steps, and bringing clarity to complex problem spaces</li> <li>Supporting the development of research operations, processes, tooling, and best practices</li> <li>Maintaining and contributing to our insights repository to ensure research findings are accessible and reusable</li> <li>Mentoring colleagues and supporting the continued growth of research maturity across the business</li> <li>Building strong relationships with stakeholders to establish effective feedback loops and strengthen the voice of the customer</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years' experience conducting UX Research within digital products or related fields</li> <li>Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and when to use them</li> <li>Experienced in independently leading complex research projects from start to finish</li> <li>Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and able to bring structure and direction to unclear problem spaces</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messages for different audiences</li> <li>Skilled at synthesising large volumes of information into clear narratives, insights, and recommendations</li> <li>Confident engaging with stakeholders, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decision-making</li> <li>Able to prioritise effectively across multiple projects, balancing business goals, customer needs, and team capacity</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent workstreams while maintaining a high standard of delivery</li> <li>Proactive, self-sufficient, and comfortable identifying and resolving blockers independently</li> <li>Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail</li> <li>Curious, analytical, and motivated to understand the "why" behind customer behaviour</li> <li>Passionate about creating user-centred products and embedding customer insight into decision-making</li> </ul> <p>This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can confidently drive research forward, even when the path ahead isn't fully defined</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <p></p> <p><strong>Our Offer</strong></p>
