title: Senior Partnerships Manager: Media & Editorial (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong> </p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.</li> <li>An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.</li> <li>Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.</li> <li>Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.</li> <li>International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.</li> <li>Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.</li> <li>Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.</li> <li>Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.</li> <li>Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.</li> <li>Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.</li> <li>Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.</li> <li>Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.</li> <li>Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.</li> <li>Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.</li> <li>Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.</li> <li>Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.</li> <li>Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.</li> <li>Fluent English essential. German or another European language advantageous.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to relevant markets as required<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <div class="TypographyPresentation title: Senior Data Scientist (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of the Role</strong></p> <p>Data sits at the heart of the company. This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy. Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.</p> <p>You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions. You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.</p> <p>In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability. You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.</li> <li>Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.</li> <li>Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.</li> <li>Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.</li> <li>Build scalable feature engineering, model development, and deployment workflows in collaboration with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams.</li> <li>Drive rapid MVP development, validating ideas quickly while ensuring a path to sustainable production solutions.</li> <li>Define and promote best practices for model development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.</li> <li>Mentor and support other data scientists, contributing to technical capability and knowledge sharing across the team.</li> <li>Communicate findings, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Contribute to the evolution of the Data Science roadmap, identifying new opportunities to apply advanced analytics and machine learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist, or similar role.</li> <li>Proven experience delivering machine learning and analytical solutions from discovery through to deployment and business impact.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Python and relevant data science libraries, including NumPy, PySpark, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and/or PyTorch.</li> <li>Strong experience using Databricks, including Jobs, Asset Bundles, Delta Lake, and MLflow.</li> <li>Experience working with business stakeholders to define problems, scope solutions, and communicate outcomes effectively.</li> <li>Experience mentoring data scientists or providing technical leadership within a cross-functional team.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer title: Senior Manager, Global Business Development Strategy & Operations
description: <h4><strong>About commercetools</strong></h4> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p>As our <strong>Senior Manager, Global BDR Function & Operations</strong>, you will lead and scale our Business Development Representative (BDR) organisation across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), you will serve as a functional leader on the Marketing Leadership Team, driving predictable enterprise pipeline growth by implementing  global outbound motions, standardizing playbooks, and being hands-on with the global BDR team. </p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the global functional lead for business development, partnering directly with the CMO to align the BDR function with overall demand generation campaigns, brand initiatives, and corporate pipeline targets.</li> <li>Partner with RevOps and Marketing to define, monitor, and optimize global Marketing–BDR SLAs, including funnel velocity, lead scoring models, speed-to-lead benchmarks, and inbound conversion strategies.</li> <li>Own global team metrics against weekly discovery and qualified opportunity targets, providing direct, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.</li> <li>Manage regional BDR teams fostering high-performance leadership standards.</li> <li>Own global team retention strategies, structuring quality-weighted compensation frameworks and clear career pathways.</li> <li>Design, implement, and maintain a single global BDR playbook covering inbound and outbound architecture, multi-channel messaging (email, phone, social), and objection handling.</li> <li>Partner with the People team to support  onboarding and enablement programs globally, incorporating formal certification milestones and structured peer-shadowing.</li> <li>Collaborate with RevOps to optimize tool adoption, AI potential and workflow efficiencies across Salesforce, Clay, Outreach, Gong/Chorus, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and 6sense/intent data platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>This role is in office with five days a week spent in our (Boston MA or London UK) office. </em></strong></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in B2B SaaS sales development,</li> <li>Proven track record leading distributed BDR/SDR organizations or managing regional team leads/managers across AMER, EMEA, or APAC.</li> <li>Demonstrated success partnering directly with Marketing Leadership (CMO/VPs) to convert marketing demand into qualified enterprise sales opportunities.</li> <li>Hands-on mastery of modern sales tech (Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, intent data, conversation intelligence) and funnel conversion analytics.</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise eCommerce, headless commerce, composable platforms, or digital experience software.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p><strong>✈️ Family Flex Program:</strong> Remote work for a number of days a year to support family connectivity </p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success </p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. </p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>. </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Web Designer, Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.</p> <p>You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.</p> <p>You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Working with Growth, Self-serve, Brand, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to turn opportunities into clear, buildable experiences.</li> <li><strong>Data and insight:</strong> Using user insights and funnel data to identify opportunities, define hypotheses, and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>Product design:</strong> Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.</li> <li><strong>Prototyping and systems:</strong> Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must have experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.</li> <li><strong>Growth mindset:</strong> A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.</li> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Craft and taste:</strong> Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.</li> <li><strong>Systems and brand:</strong> Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who this role is not for</strong></h2> <p>This role is not for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.</li> <li>You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.</li> <li>You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.</li> <li>You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.</li> <li>You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.</li> <li>You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>You’ll know you’re successful if:</p> <ul> <li>More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.</li> <li>You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.</li> <li>Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.</li> <li>You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.</li> <li>You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.</li> <li>You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.</p> <p>You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.</p> <h2><strong>Ready to build something great?</strong></h2> <p>If you’re excited by the opportunity to help existing businesses get more value from a self-serve product, and you have the craft, curiosity, commercial thinking, and autonomy to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director - Alliance Management
description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering a unique opportunity for an experienced Associate Director in Alliance Management to ensure that our strategic pharma partnerships continue to thrive and deliver. Working across high-profile collaborations including GSK and Novartis, you will be the connective tissue between Relation and our partners - building trusted relationships, creating clarity across complex collaborations and helping both organisations work together effectively towards shared strategic goals. You will sit at the centre of Relation’s partnership model, working closely with Programme Leaders, interdisciplinary teams and senior leaders across Relation and our partner organisations. You will have a highly visible role to safeguard relationship health, contractual alignment and forward visibility - ensuring that the right conversations happen at the right time, commitments are clearly understood, risks and opportunities are surfaced early, and that governance enables high-quality decision making at pace. You will bring together different perspectives with clarity and pragmatism, helping our partnerships operate as one team, while ensuring commitment to Relation’s high scientific standards, platform integrity and strategic priorities. The delivery of successful partnerships strengthen both partner organisations, and ultimately help to fulfill Relation’s goal of bringing transformational medicines to patients. Day to day you will: Manage the health and effectiveness of strategic pharma partnerships , building trusted relationships across Relation and partner organisations and influencing cross-functional stakeholders at all levels to maintain alignment and momentum. Shape and steward partnership governance , ensuring governance meetings focus on the decisions, risks and opportunities that matter, with clear ownership, effective escalation and disciplined follow-through. Maintain forward visibility across each alliance , anticipating relational, contractual and governance risks and opportunities and ensuring they are surfaced early to the appropriate decision-makers. Safeguard contractual alignment , maintaining oversight of scope, milestones, reporting requirements, financial triggers, data-sharing commitments and other obligations; translating contractual terms into clear implications for teams and governance. Influence across organisational boundaries , connecting Programme Leaders, interdisciplinary teams, senior leadership and partner stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, navigate competing perspectives and enable timely decisions. Lead alliance-level escalation , bringing clarity to complex or sensitive issues and ensuring escalation strengthens decision-making. Shape new partnerships from diligence through launch , collaborating closely with Growth, Corporate and Business Development to embed effective governance, contractual clarity and practical ways of working from the outset. Raise the standard of partnering at Relation , applying learning across collaborations to strengthen governance, alliance management and organisational partnering capability as Relation’s portfolio grows. Professionally, you will have: A university degree in a relevant scientific or technical field, or equivalent experience. Significant experience in alliance management or strategic partnerships within biotech or pharmaceutical R&D , including substantial experience working with large pharmaceutical partners. Deep expertise working with complex collaboration agreements , with the judgement to interpret contractual commitments, identify implications and risks, and translate them into clear actions or governance decisions. Experience working in data-rich, technology-enabled or AI/ML-enabled R&D environments is key, particularly in partnerships involving contractual alignment at the intersection of data, technology and intellectual property. Strong scientific and drug discovery fluency, enabling you to operate credibly with senior scientific leaders and interdisciplinary teams. A track record of influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority , navigating organisational complexity and building alignment across companies, disciplines and competing priorities. Strong governance judgement, with experience bringing complex scientific, commercial, contractual and relational issues to senior decision-making forums. Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders and external partners. Confidence navigating disagreement, ambiguity and sensitive partner issues with diplomacy, sound judgement and integrity . The ability to maintain strategic perspective and forward visibility while overseeing multiple complex partnerships in a fast-moving environment. Bonus experience: Professional alliance management accreditation, such as ASAP CA-AM or CSAP , is desirable. Personally, you: Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams. Take ownership of your work , proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work. Communicate openly and directly , give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect. Actively seek out diverse perspectives , build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams. Embrace challenges with openness and resilience , set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working Style & Culture at Relation At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment , where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs. Relation is a committed equal opportunities employer. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Scientist (Single Cell)
description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Data Scientist to help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour, with a focus on single cell multi-omics. Your work will be central to our mission to understand and control cellular decision-making, enabling novel therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models. You'll be joining a team with access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced computational infrastructure, and deep interdisciplinary expertise, and a culture that embraces modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows, to accelerate research iteration. You will contribute advanced data analysis and domain expertise to challenge ML models that aim to predict and explain cellular decision-making in disease. Day to day, you will Process and QC paired single-cell RNA-seq and scATAC-seq at scale from thousands of perturbations across diverse cell types and biological contexts. Develop and maintain Nextflow pipelines compatible with custom combinatorial indexing chemistries and including methods such as STARsolo, Alevin-fry, Chromap, and SnapATAC2. title: Senior Software Engineer, Sandboxes (London or East Coast Preferred)
description: About Docker Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default. _______________________________________________________________________ The Docker Sandboxes team is building the runtime that lets AI coding agents run safely on a developer's machine: disposable, isolated microVM sandboxes that each get their own Docker daemon, filesystem, and network. This is the core of Docker's sbx product: developers can give an agent the autonomy it needs to get real work done without it ever touching the host, and tear the whole environment down when it's finished. The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure, isolated runtime environments (sandboxes, containers, or VMs) and a track record of shipping and owning that kind of infrastructure in production at scale. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas. They can drive clarity and consensus on hard, ambiguous problems that cross team and component boundaries, raise the bar for engineering quality wherever they work, thrive in a remote-first environment, communicate clearly across time zones, work with our users, while bringing curiosity and craftsmanship to hard problems. Please note: this role is currently prioritizing candidates currently located in the Eastern time zone (US or Canada), or in the EU. Responsibilities Design, develop, and lead improvements to the sandboxes product across agent integration, tool permissions, and developer-facing workflows. title: (Junior) PR & Communications Manager EMEA
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the Role Statista is seeking a (Junior) PR & Communications Manager to support and shape communications activities across the EMEA region, with a clear focus on Germany and the UK. Reporting to the Head of PR & Communications, you will turn Statista’s data, products, and corporate stories into compelling narratives, proactive media relations, and relevant communications content. This is a hands-on role for a professional at the beginning of their career. You will take ownership of day-to-day PR execution in Germany and the UK while working closely with an international PR & Communications team. The ideal candidate is a strong writer and proactive communicator who understands what makes a story relevant for journalists, enjoys turning complex topics into clear narratives, and is excited to grow their career in a fast-moving global company. If you thrive on making things happen and want to make a real impact by empowering people with data to make fact-based decisions, this is your opportunity. Key Responsibilities Execute day-to-day PR and communications activities across EMEA, with a clear focus on Germany and the UK – in alignment with business objectives and the global communications strategy. Draft, edit, and tailor communications materials in German and English, including press releases, media pitches, op-eds, expert commentary, media alerts, Q&As, briefing documents, and key messages. Help plan and execute always-on media relations activities to secure earned media coverage across Tier 1 and Tier 2 business, technology, trade, national, and podcast media; including monitoring of industry trends and news developments to identify proactive PR opportunities. Support the planning and execution of integrated communications campaigns, including thought leadership and corporate announcements (e.g., product news, business developments). Build and maintain relationships with journalists, editors and relevant industry influencers across German and UK business, technology, national, and trade media. Help position and prepare executives, industry experts, and researchers for media interviews, speaking engagements, and other external appearances to ensure impactful and consistent representation of Statista across the EMEA region. Create and manage LinkedIn content for executives, translating business priorities, data, and thought-leadership topics into authentic, engaging executive communications. Contribute to PR & communications work beyond the core Germany and UK remit where needed, including support for U.S. PR activities, and media outreach across other EMEA markets. Help manage and coordinate PR-related partnerships and external speaking opportunities Qualifications 2–3+ years of relevant professional experience in PR, corporate communications, brand communications, journalism, or a related field, gained in-house or at a PR/communications agency. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. Strong writing and editing skills, with experience producing high-quality press materials, media pitches, and other editorial content for different audiences. Experience in media relations, including pitching stories that resonate with journalists, responding to media requests, and building relationships with journalists and editors. A good understanding of the German media landscape; an initial understanding of the EMEA region, especially the UK media market and existing relationships with UK journalists are a plus. Ability to identify compelling angles and turn complex information, products, and business topics into clear and relevant stories that resonate with media. A proactive, collaborative, and reliable working style, with the confidence to engage constructively with cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within a global organization or agency Experienced in analyzing data and data-led storytelling. Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership programs. Curiosity about business, technology, AI, and data topics that shape public discussion. Familiarity with AI-enabled communications is a plus. Why Statista At Statista, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions through trusted data and insights. Join us in shaping how businesses, organizations, and individuals understand the world through data. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍London - Hybrid | 💰£125,000 - £145,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</h4> <p> </p> <h4>Our Payments team⭐</h4> <p>Payments is at the heart of Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p> </p> <h4>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role is hybrid working from our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director</li> <li>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership</li> <li>Third stage - Product full loop</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.<br><br>#LI-HR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

In this role, you will play a key part in shifting us from AI as a productivity tool to AI as a core part of how our marketing team operates to hit its outcomes. You will lead the workstreams and build agents to transform how we produce content at scale, while supporting the adoption of AI applications more broadly across the business. Throughout, you'll unlock new AI capabilities and the systems integrations that make them work within the guardrails of a regulated, financial-services environment.</p> <p>This is a role for a first-principles and systems thinker: someone who can break a complex problem down to its fundamentals, design how the pieces fit together, and build. You'll be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, and you'll be excellent at navigating a complex, stakeholder-heavy environment to get things done.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Martech & AI and sits within the Martech team, part of the Growth Collective. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be involved in:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Programme management:</strong> Leading our content scaling programme including translating goals into sequenced, actionable work, driving delivery, and coordinating owners and stakeholders across a complex environment.</p> <p><strong>Building AI agents:</strong> Designing and building AI agents (using tools like Claude) to transform how we produce and scale content. This means turning repeatable, manual work into reliable, well-governed automated flows, with clear judgement on where a human stays in the loop.</p> <p><strong>Systems integration and governance:</strong> Connecting AI and agents into our martech stack and data to unlock new capabilities. This means building the integrations that make them work, and doing it safely in a regulated, financial-services environment (i.e. with data protection, compliance, and the right controls built in).</p> <p><strong>Creative AI tooling:</strong> Running discovery on creative AI tooling. This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. This means driving a rigorous selection process from requirements through vendor evaluation to a clear, well-justified recommendation.</p> <p><strong>AI adoption across the business:</strong> Championing the adoption of AI-driven solutions beyond the programme, including helping other teams understand and apply AI, and sharing what works.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building and applying AI for teams. You can point to agents, automations, or AI-driven workflows you've built and shipped that others came to rely on, ideally for a marketing or content team with people and stakeholders in the mix.</li> <li>You have strong programme leadership. You've led cross-functional programmes or workstreams end to end, sequencing the work, managing dependencies and risk, keeping stakeholders aligned, and driving delivery to a successful outcome (including picking up work already in flight).</li> <li>You're a first-principles and systems thinker who can break down a complex, ambiguous problem, design how the parts fit together, and build a solution.</li> <li>You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and in complex, stakeholder-heavy environments, working with individuals at all levels to get things done.</li> <li>You have a working understanding of marketing and how content and creative are produced. You know what "good" needs to look like and how to build the right guardrails around it.</li> <li>You bring martech literacy and can run a rigorous tooling selection process. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £80,000 - £100,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p>📍 This role can be offered in a hybrid approach, working from our London office and home.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 Application journey key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call with a member of the hiring team (30 minutes)</li> <li>Initial Call with the Hiring Manager (30 minutes)</li> <li>Case Study Review Call (45 minutes) & Behavioural interview (45 minutes)</li> <li>Final Interview with the Hiring Manager, and a member of the Marketing Leadership Team (30 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks – your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. You will act as the crucial link between our central teams and our local country Marketing Leads to set every new market up for success.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Go-to-Market Launch & Marketing: Executing and helping build a plan for Business Banking launches in new markets, including media/channel strategies, communication tactics, and integrated marketing campaigns. </li> <li>Integrated Marketing across channels: Developing and implementing marketing plans across multiple channels, including digital, social, and traditional media. </li> <li>Creative problem-solver: Working with the team to market to a new audience and find innovative ways to grow the brand. </li> <li>Tackling ambiguity: You can take away ambiguous business problems or customer challenges and come up with a plan to tackle them.</li> <li>Keeping everyone aligned: In a fast-moving expansion, you think ahead and communicate ahead of time, setting a rhythm of updates and anticipating stakeholder questions.</li> <li>Working with Creative and Media agencies: Partnering with best in class agencies and own day to day agency management. </li> <li>Media and Communications: Working in partnership with our Communications Team to execute on strategies to build brand awareness and drive engagement.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Working with stakeholders within Monzo to align marketing efforts with overall business objectives. </li> <li>Brand Consistency: Upholding Monzo's brand identity and values while adapting to the nuances of the local market. Ensure consistency in messaging and branding across all touchpoints.</li> <li>Reporting: Working with data teams to report frequently on key metrics, providing insights and actions.</li> <li>Regulatory Compliance: Navigating the regulatory landscape in Italy to ensure all marketing activities adhere to local regulation</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of launching new products or entering new markets, and have owned medium-sized projects that required cross-team collaboration and have delivered them successfully. </li> <li>You're hands-on and comfortable executing campaigns, building websites, and configuring CRM journeys.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in complex environments. teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is £294,000 per year. to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li>
